design.unit: film: clip probabilities averaged per film, genre predicted if >= 0.5; a film's labels are its clips' (identical within a film)
design.protocol: 10x5 RepeatedGroupKFold by film, nested C, OOF-trained emotions; the arms and folds of exp_cv_corrected.py
design.metric: macro-F1 over films, once per repeat on the pooled out-of-fold predictions; clip-level macro-F1 from the same predictions alongside
design.significance: paired film bootstrap, 2000 draws (the draws of cv_corrected.json), averaged over repeats; clip-level Nadeau-Bengio kept beside it (not defined per film: a test fold holds about 8 films)
